Common_Smut also shows black galls — doesn't match.

- Crazy_Top reference: nearly identical appearance — tassel replaced by dense, leafy/proliferating vegetative structures
- Head_Smut: black sooty mass — ruled out
- Common_Smut: black galls — ruled out

Crazy_Top (caused by *Sclerophthora macrospora*) is the clear match.
